issue.title: sase-core flake: permission_denied_cwd_fails_before_dispatch_when_supported parses empty JSON under parallel load
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1pn.2 note #3. The phase reports one failure in the parallel sase-core just check: permission_denied_cwd_fails_before_dispatch_when_supported panicked parsing JSON at EOF, then passed alone on unchanged clean HEAD. Population failure rate is unknown. The epic core diff 1762b33a changes only agent_launch, not sudo_runner. This node calls ledger(&stdout) after Fixture::run; missing output is known, its cause is not. Existing sase-15h covers proven ETXTBSY on the shared fixture, and sase-15e covers empty worker.pid; neither proves this stdout JSON failure is a duplicate. Investigate and retain the runner result/stdout/stderr before choosing the fix; do not weaken permission-denial assertions. Size large because the cause is unknown.
